## Implementation Report — round 1

**Status:** READY-FOR-REVIEW

### (a) What was done

Built the per-substrate map-fit + activation-dump rig for the 50-input battery map, reusing the #667/#722/#658 fit machinery verbatim over a fresh extraction (the #667 16-source store is NOT reused — wrong input layout, plan §4.1). All work in `.claude/worktrees/issue-813` on branch `issue-813`.

- `scripts/issue813_run_cell.py` (NEW, +600): ONE `(behavior, substrate)` cell. Stages the #537 `default`-context adapter via the reused `resolve_adapter_subfolder` (handles em's NESTED `sft_em_adapter/`), asserts base-id + `use_rslora` (fitness (f)/(g), reused `assert_adapter_gauge`), vLLM-batches the frozen base R, teacher-forces `T_ctx(q)+R` through base+trained via `extract_layer_activations` hooks, captures FULL per-token residual (28 layers, fp16, both models), STREAM-UPLOADS the unreduced `.npz` per (ctx,q) then deletes-local (df EDQUOT fail-loud floor at 10 GiB), reduces to question-averaged c_C (last-input-token) + v_A (mean-answer-span) all 28 layers, and persists per-question headline-L14 rows for the null. `max_new_tokens`: marker 2048 / others 1024.
- `scripts/issue813_dispatch.py` (NEW, +264): 8-way CVD fan-out over the 12 (behavior×substrate) cells. `compute_wave_size = min(len(cells), visible_gpus)` + per-lane `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<gpu>` in the LAUNCHER env matching `--gpu-id` (#667 a36 / #545), verbatim contract from `issue667_alllayer_dispatch`. Explicit `env={**os.environ}` per subprocess + module-top `load_dotenv()`.
- `scripts/issue813_save_maps.py` (NEW, +241): M0/M⁺ ridge maps per (behavior, substrate, layer) via `issue667_save_maps.fit_and_save_cell` + `correctness_gate` (the `<1e-8` exact-reproduction gate, top-64 V0-PCA basis shared by both maps — `TARGET_DIM=64`, NEVER 48). Output `eval_results/issue_813_maps/<behavior>/<substrate>/L<layer>.npz`.
- `scripts/issue813_analysis.py` (NEW, +417): DVs at the FROZEN headline layer 14 (selection-symmetric, applied identically to observed + null). em/fact/syco → `fitM.fit_cell(..., include_mlp=False)` (Δ/floor + chain-ρ + support_distance + n_with_E). **marker → `issue667_marker_mapchange.fit_marker_layer` (read-1 unproj ‖ΔM‖/floor + read-2 W_U[※]-proj + `frac_in_subspace` gate) — NOT `fit_cell`, which KeyErrors on marker (no r_B).** Substrate-swap null (matched-n: resample questions within a substrate, re-split into two matched-n pseudo-substrates, |Δ/floor(A)−Δ/floor(B)|, p95 = threshold X). Pairwise substrate-difference.
- `scripts/issue813_dispatch.sh` (NEW, +207): pod-side phase orchestrator (apply-parity → one-cell gate → extract → fit-maps → analysis), `[phase=...]` breadcrumbs, end-of-run sentinel to `/workspace/logs/issue-813-epm_results-<epoch>.json` with poll_pipeline keys (`sentinel_schema_version=1`, `kind`, `version`), single terminal `[phase=done]` after the sentinel. `--smoke` = same phases at 1 cell. NEVER shells `task.py`.
- `tests/test_issue813_wave_and_skip.py` (NEW, +137): wave-size + CVD-pin + resume-skip regression (mirrors `test_issue667_alllayer_wave.py`).

- Diff: +1870 across 6 files (my two commits): `git diff --stat ea8a86ff2e~1..HEAD -- scripts tests`.
- Plan adherence (§4.5 "New code"): `issue813_extract.py`→ MODIFIED to `issue813_run_cell.py` + `issue813_dispatch.py` split (the brief's `.py` driver + `.sh`) — DONE. `issue813_save_maps.py` DONE. `issue813_analysis.py` DONE. All 10 load-bearing critic constraints addressed (see (c)).
- Commits: `ea8a86ff2e` per-substrate map-fit + activation-dump dispatcher / `04e328a89f` strip [phase=done] from subprocesses (#545 guard).
- Branch: `issue-813` pushed to origin. No PR opened (orchestrator handles the draft PR).

### (b) Considered but not done

- **CLAUDE.md gotchas cited:** (1) **vLLM worker-subprocess teardown** — reused `vllm_generate_R` from `issue667_extract.py`, which reaps the engine (`_reap_vllm_engine` + `ipc_collect`) before the HF teacher-force pass; I did not re-implement it. (2) **vLLM fork-poisoning** — inherited the `VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn` module-top guard. (3) **CVD clobber (#545)** — pinned CVD in the launcher env per lane AND passed `--gpu-id`; the in-process `cuda:0` clobber is defeated by import-time cuInit unless the launcher pins CVD, so both are set. (4) **MooseFS ~130 GB EDQUOT** — stream-upload-then-delete per cell + a df fail-loud floor; peak local footprint ≈ one cell. (5) **HF 256-commits/hr throttle** — the fit-maps upload is a single bulk `upload_folder`; the per-cell unreduced uploads are paced by the 8-way wave (plan §8).
- **Chose per-cell `HfApi.upload_file` (run_cell) over the raw-completions helper:** `upload_raw_completions_to_data_repo` globs `raw_completions.json`; #813's unreduced store is a different shape (`unreduced/<beh>/<sub>/<ctx>__q<i>.npz`), so I upload per-file directly to the canonical dataset repo. This is NOT a raw-completions path (no per-cell completion JSONs are written) — the upload-wiring `### upload wiring` note in (c) documents this. Considered a bulk-commit batch but the stream-then-delete peak-footprint requirement (EDQUOT) requires per-file upload+delete, not accumulate+batch.
- **fit-maps `<behavior>/<substrate>/` layout via scratch-relocate:** `fit_and_save_cell` hardcodes `out_dir/<behavior>/L*.npz`; to nest the substrate I fit into `out_dir/_scratch/<substrate>` then `shutil.move` to the canonical path. Considered re-implementing the save inline (would drift from the reused `<1e-8`-gated helper) — rejected; the relocate keeps the fit byte-for-byte the reused helper's output.
- **No training in this diff** — all 4 adapters are reused #537 artifacts; marker-training-recipe / band-stop gotchas N/A. The marker DV read follows `marker-leakage-measurement.md` (id-83399 assert in `load_wu_marker_direction`, on-policy frozen R).
- **Substrate-swap null persists only headline-L14 per-question rows** (not all 28 layers per question) — the null reads at the frozen L14 only, and all-28-layer per-question would balloon the reduced dir ~28×. The map-fit inputs (question-averaged, all 28 layers) are unaffected.
